The work reaches review only after lint, simulation, and synthesis (and formal, when a .sby is written) pass on those files.
constraints: Work only from the approved interface specification and microarchitecture.
Lint-clean under Verilator -Wall with no waivers.
known_failure_modes: Unmapped or misaligned addresses answered OKAY instead of SLVERR.
wstrb ignored or applied to the wrong byte lanes.
READY driven combinationally from VALID, against the specification.
A self-written testbench too weak to notice the above; the held-out reference testbench judges instead.
